variables.name: dose_group
variables.original: Exp group (0 = low dose, 1 = high dose)

cleaning_notes: Raw columns not read: H-1, H0, H1, H2, H3, H4, H4.1, H5, H6, H7, H8 (Clinical 'H' habitus scores go to the outcomes file).
Dog 1 (splenectomised donor, one baseline sample) is excluded, as the package file requires.

One record per dog and sampling day. 'day' is the column suffix of the raw file (days after inoculation, -1 to 8; the file does not define the unit). The raw suffix '4.1' (low-dose dogs only) is an extra day-4 sample: timepoint 'day_4_1', day 4, sample 'second_day4_sample'.

post_treatment is true for days 5 to 8. Treatment was at about 96 h (high dose) and 108 h (low dose) per the record; the file has no treatment column. Day 4 and the 4.1 sample are taken as pre-treatment (inferred).

Dose group: Exp group 0 = low dose (10^4), 1 = high dose. The Notes sheet says 10^9 for the high dose; CB101 says 10^8 (unresolved, record). Stored as the design variable dose_group (low/high), not as a severity label.
One dog has no clinical or haematology record after day 4 (death on day 4, CB101). Its missing later days are informative, not random.

FLAG: the same dog has a parasitaemia of 0 in the day-6 column (raw cell Parasitaemias!K7), two days after its death. The value is kept as reported and flagged here; treat it as a probable entry error. Affected dog-days: 1.
Cytokine values of 0 are kept as 0 and flagged 'floor' in censored (below detection; no detection limits in the file). Counts: gmcsf 5, ifng 15, il15 2, il18 2, il2 7, ip10 12, tnfa 1.
CRP values of 10 are kept and flagged 'floor' (9 samples): 10 is the reporting floor (record).

In the high-dose dogs the 4.1 column is empty except for Retic% and Retic (reticulocytes), which hold a value there. These values are kept as reported (timepoint day_4_1); their sampling time is not documented. DS03 does not include them.
MCHC converted from g/dL to g/L (x10). No other unit was changed.
Floating-point noise in the cells was rounded to 10 decimals (0.28999999999999998 -> 0.29).
Very high cytokine values on days 6 and 8 in one high-dose dog (IL-6, IL-8 and others above 10,000 pg/mL) are kept as reported; CB098 reports a post-treatment cytokine surge.
Clinical lactate (lactate_clinical) and venous blood gas lactate (lactate) are two measurements; the harmonised 'lactate' is the blood gas value.
The DS03 experimental file holds the same 5 dogs (identical Hb, HCT, Ret% and ARC values; DS03 days 1-6 = DS02 days 1-6, without the 4.1 sample). See the DS03 features file, field same_dog_as.
DS01 (Mendeley) repeats these dogs and values and has no tidy file of its own.
